item.title: Microsoft publishes its October 2026 security update release, including Windows updates
item.description: Microsoft: Microsoft’s Security Update Guide lists its October 2026 security release as released on October 26 and includes cumulative updates for Windows. The release page reports 1,105 Windows vulnerabilities addressed and flags a Windows Shell security feature bypass vulnerability with exploitation detected.
